profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Macy’s Systems and Technology Inc | Java | Spring Boot | Microservices | Kafka | Kubernetes | OpenAI APIs | RAG | AI Agents | MCP | Prompt Engineering
profile.summary:
• 6+ years of software development experience spanning backend, frontend, databases, cloud, and AI/LLM technologies.
• Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications using OpenAI APIs, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), FAISS, prompt engineering, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
• Google Cloud Certified Associate Cloud Engineer with hands-on GCP application development experience.
• Proficient in designing and developing microservices using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Kafka, Kubernetes, React.js, and Node.js.
• Strong understanding of distributed systems, data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and debugging complex applications.
• Skilled in designing scalable, reliable, high-performance software solutions with a passion for continuously learning and applying emerging AI technologies.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
-       Drive technical leadership in designing and developing scalable software solutions while providing guidance through code reviews, mentoring, and engineering best practices.
 -       Collaborate with Principal Engineers on system design and lead teams in building, owning, and delivering business-critical applications. 
-       Leverage Gemini Code Assist to enhance development productivity through feature development, debugging, code reviews, and production support.
-       Develop cloud-native microservices using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, relational databases (MySQL, Oracle), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services.
-       Utilize GCP services including Kubernetes, Kafka, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Scheduler, and Pub/Sub to build scalable solutions.
-       Partner with DevOps teams to identify and optimize cloud cost drivers through logging optimization, workload scaling improvements, and application performance enhancements.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-	Working as a Senior Software Engineer, to develop and deploy software applications projects using java spring boot-microservices, with ReactJS, NodeJS, and GCP (Google Cloud Platform) technology.
-	Collaborate with cross-functional teams and business partners to implement or code new/existing features, and support consumer solutions using new and effective technology.
-	Taking ownership to work with enterprise architects to design architecture and technical solutions.
-	Efficiency to work on GCP products like Kubernetes, Big Query, Dataflow, logging, and Spanner database.
-	Experienced to work with Cloud publisher-subscriber concept with implementing alerts to avoid issues.
-	Responsible to assist and manage junior engineers’ work, such as reviewing code by fulfilling industry and company standard code writing with gaining effective performance.
-	Create design documents about requirements, and configurations using confluence and use JIRA & Git to maintain effective development of the projects. 
-	Developing leadership, ownership, and decision-making skills, by working with architectures and co-workers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-	Experienced to develop projects in JAVA, Spring frameworks including Spring Boot, Maven dependencies, GCP (Google Cloud Platform), JPA repository, deploying microservices in the cloud infrastructure, NodeJS, ReactJS as a front-end and data parsing, handling using REST API and MYSQL, SQL server as a back-end database with Jenkins, Spinnaker pipelines for the building of scalable software. 
-	Performed Debugging, Monitoring, and testing of software using J-Unit, functional testing, E2E and fix bugs in applications. 
- Enhanced problem-solving, creative thinking, and decision-making skills, by working with application and deployment teams.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
-	Worked with senior software engineers to design, develop and enhance the company’s product. 
-	Supported existing applications by fixing bugs and upgraded an automated testing framework with modification of a code. 
-	Worked on the implementation of the front-end and back-end side of an application in Python programming using the Django framework, API requests, Docker, containers, and Jenkins.  
-	Experinced in Bootstrap, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery and JavaScript with the Django framework. 
-	Created documentation about functionality flow and design of a product. 
-	The project environment included SDLC concepts and a sprint development environment. 
-	Collaboration with different team members, helped to increase skills in teamwork, leadership, and management.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
-	As an Intern, responsible to develop an automated testing framework for validation and check the effectiveness.
-	Automated testing framework software helped to fetch data from the client’s field and process the data to generate a client’s monitoring system such as an alarm system, and graphical representation. Developed an automated testing framework at the initial level. 
-	Development of automated testing framework includes programming in Python with JSON for the data parsing and validation, data handling using URL API request, and using Linux. 
-	Documented the details of configurations and other important details of the application using standard industry tools. 
-	Experienced with software development tools like JIRA, Confluence, Git, and Bitbucket.
-	Developed critical thinking, work ethic, and software development skills by dealing with new projects.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Worked with the professor to assist students with the course database management systems (DBMS).
- Provided solutions for technical problems of students’ assignments in MYSQL and SQL databases.
- Grade student assignments and quizzes.
- Guided students and solved issues in projects.
- Interaction with students, results to grow convincing and communication skills.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Major responsibility included assisting students in the development of a website in ASP.net for the course web application development and providing solutions for the course web fundamentals.
- Provided guidance and graded students’ web application assignments and projects based on C#, ASP.net MVC with HTML, Bootstrap, CSS, XML, JavaScript, and AJAX.
- Worked with professor and solved technical issues, including connectivity issues of connecting the university server.
- Enhanced presentation, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.

positions.title: Student Tech 2(NCWS Stu Asst II)
positions.description:
- Hired as an Operations Assistant at Campus Recreation and Wellness Center of the University. 
- Got training of handle the front-desk, equipment check-in and check-out process. Technical training for the handling online portal for of students’, faculties’ and other members’ membership information.

projects.title: Building Smart Drones using ArduCopter and Telemetry
projects.description:
- Built drone from scratch and created a tutorial with details of components needs, assembling and calibration
of the drone with details of controlling and flying of a drone. Configured different types of drones.
- Implemented with GPS signal, and radio signal with Smartphone to handle the drone.
- Link for the video tutorial: https://lnkd.in/eqvTQ7Z, which has been created as a part of this project’s deliverables.

projects.title: Development in python and Django
projects.description:
- Developed the front end of the product in python with the Django framework.
- Used JavaScript, jQuery plugins, Bootstrap, and JSON for data configuration and validations.
